evidence: A model result of the offline storm-water chain on the design years (A28R_301k_design_l15_snow_s934, years 10-19) and geography's 1.9 km depression tree, for PlaSim's hollows' store (climate/gcm/land_store.py). The store's curves sum phase 2b's hollows with a cell's water shared among them by their own yearly inflow, each at most full, where phase 2b's pools fill, spill and dry each on its own; the cost of that lumping is measured offline (session-tools/agents/storm_water/stage_b2_report.md). The balanced volumes meet the store's mean inflow with its mean losses at phase 2b's lunar-day pool evaporation, as phase 2b starts its pools. The floors are designs (a clay seal scaled from the HAPEX-Sahel plateau pools, sandy banks above a 1 m stage, a seal ten times tighter), the bowls' counts the terrain study's equilibrium law, their shape half Pike's fresh depth, and the routing shares phase 2a's routing under stand-in storms (Walnut Gulch's measured family and CM1's 6 km window over wet ground). The runoff tables are phase 2a's own wetting tables for those storms and phase 1's steady 2 mm/h large-scale rain (an estimate), Green and Ampt at lunar gravity on designed surfaces; read at each 3-day mean's own rain and bucket they give phase 2a's runoff. No PlaSim run has used these tables.
reading_rule: Each cell is a T21 point j * nlon + i of PlaSim's grid (north to south from 0 E). Depths, areas, rates and seepage are per unit of the grid's dryland area in the cell (dryland_km2), the basis of phase 2a's fates and phase 2b's per-cell results, which PlaSim carries over the whole T21 cell as it carries the bucket. store[library][surface][age].capacity_m is the hollows' total volume (m of water) and area_share and seepage_m_s (per floor) the water area's share and the floors' seepage (m/s) with the store holding the share grids.fill of its capacity, the water shared among the hollows by their yearly inflow and each hollow at most full; read between fills linearly in the square root of the fill and nil at nil volume. balanced_m (per floor) is the store's balanced volume, its start where a run holds no store, and inflow_m_s the mean runoff reaching the hollows that the balance takes, before the store's own water area replaces its share of the slopes (the balance: inflow_m_s (1 - a) + a (rain_m_s.total - e) - seepage = 0, with a the area share and e pool_evaporation_m_s at the store's mean depth on grids.pool_depth_m, linear in the depth's logarithm). shares[library][surface][age] split the slopes' runoff into the hollows, the rivers (the sea and the humid land), the ground below the roots (recharge) and the soil (the slopes' and channel beds' soak above the roots); they sum to 1. convective_runoff[library][surface][rain][wetness] is the slopes' runoff per millimetre of convective rain and large_scale_runoff[surface][rain][wetness] per millimetre of large-scale rain, bilinear in grids.rain_mm_day (a 3-day mean of that rain, mm/day; the tables are built on means of basis.mean_days) and grids.wetness (the bucket's water over its 0.5 m capacity), held within both grids. rain_m_s holds the record's mean rain, the start of PlaSim's running means.
